PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glucose Control Program (Gym)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve body composition and glycaemic control through structured resistance training with cardio, plus nutrition guidance tailored for T2DM on metformin"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Intro & Base Loading":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell goblet squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          bike 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression & Form":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell goblet squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume Build A":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell goblet squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          bike 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload & Technique":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell goblet squat 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 6 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Accessory Focus + Cardio":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Calf raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable tricep pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable bicep curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          incline treadmill walking 20 minutes at moderate pace
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression Phase 2":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 6 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Conditioning & Core":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Glute bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Russian twists 3x20 (10 each side) rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Plank 3x30 seconds rest 30 seconds
        cardio:
          rower 10 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength & Fat Loss Peak 1":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 6 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Endurance & Core":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Calf raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable tricep pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable bicep curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          treadmill incline walk 20 minutes
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength & Fat Loss Peak 2":
        warmup:
          cardio 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 6 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Wrap & Maintenance Prep":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell chest press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          rower 12 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes

NUTRITION PLAN (diabetes-conscious, practical)
  - Daily energy: Start with a modest 500 kcal/day deficit from maintenance, adjust based on weekly weight trends (-0.5 to -1.0 kg per week as a target). Personalized via scale and waist measurements.
  - Macronutrient targets (adjustable by insulin/meter readings; consult clinician as needed):
    - Protein: 1.6–2.0 g per kg bodyweight per day to preserve lean mass (approx 90–120 g/day for typical client)
    - Carbohydrates: 25–35 g per meal, prioritize low-glycemic index sources; total daily carbs tailored to activity and glucose logs
    - Fats: fill remaining calories with healthy fats; emphasize monounsaturated and omega-3 fats
  - Meal timing and structure:
    - Regular meals and 1–2 snacks; avoid long fasting periods
    - Include protein with every meal to support satiety and glycemic control
    - Pre/post workout nutrition: small high-protein, moderate-carb snack if workouts occur near mealtimes
  - Carbohydrate management:
    - Distribute carbs across 3–4 meals; use consistent carb portions to support stable glucose
    - Prefer non-starchy vegetables, whole grains (oats, quinoa, brown rice), legumes, fruits in controlled portions
  - Glycemic monitoring:
    - Regular glucose checks per clinician guidance (e.g., before meals and 1–2 hours after meals on selected days) to assess response to training and nutrition changes
    - Target fasting glucose roughly 80–130 mg/dL; postprandial targets per clinician guidance
  - Metformin considerations:
    - Hydration, watch for GI symptoms; follow doctor’s dose timing
    - Alcohol moderation and consistent timing relative to meals
  - Fiber and micronutrients:
    - Aim for 25–38 g/day of fiber; ensure adequate vitamin D, calcium, magnesium, and potassium through diet or supplements if advised
  - Hydration:
    - 30–35 ml/kg/day baseline; adjust around training on hot days
  - Sleep and stress:
    - Aim for 7–9 hours; implement sleep hygiene and stress management to support glycemic control
  - Supplements (only if advised by clinician):
    - Protein powder to meet daily protein goals if needed
    - Vitamin D, calcium, magnesium supplements if dietary intake is insufficient or clinician recommendations
  - Safe considerations:
    - Avoid high-sugar meals and sugary beverages; monitor for signs of hypoglycemia during early weeks; carry fast-acting carbs as advised

DIAGNOSTIC & SAFETY NOTES
  - Exercise safety: For T2DM, focus on resistance training and gradual progression; include warmups and cooldowns; monitor for neuropathy risk; ensure footwear and form are correct
  - Contraindications avoided: No high-impact jumps or plyometrics if not suitable for client; substitute with low-impact alternatives
  - Medical: Recommend ongoing clinician collaboration; ensure HbA1c targets and metformin plan align with training program

OUTPUT_REQUIREMENTS
  - Provide a single WPL-AI document with the above PLAN structure and content
  - Follow syntax rules: reps as 3x8..12 with rpe after, rest in seconds, proper indentation per DSL
  - Do not include prose outside of DSL
